work: Qualified and created the Garmisch-Partenkirchen summer toboggan run as one standalone attraction; published eight localized pages, exact credited photo and Facebook announcement; reconciled two Wiegand reference IDs into a retained duplicate backlog record.
qualification: The official operator and local tourism directory identify the same single standalone summer toboggan site beside the Olympic ski jumping stadium. Wiegand references location-id-1279 (1996 installation) and location-id-1280 (2013 work/spiral) at this location; they do not justify two separate attraction fiches. Official editor Park and StandaloneAttraction searches for Sommerrodelbahn Garmisch, Skistadion and Garmisch in Germany found no preexisting match.

officialFacts.statusOn2026-11-15: TemporarilyClosed; operator states Geschlossen and Geöffnet: Ostern 2027
officialFacts.rainRule: Operations stop immediately when track is wet or raining

sourceLimitations: Official homepage marks the attraction closed with reopening at Easter 2027. No operating weekly hours or current public tariff was encoded while closed; reconfirm opening and fares on reopening.

The official website displays prices during seasonal closure. The editor rejects active pricing for a TemporarilyClosed standalone attraction, so the display prices are preserved only as research evidence here, not offered as current visitor prices.
Operator names the square Karl-Martin-Neuner-Platz while regional tourism and OSM use Karl-und-Martin-Neuner-Platz; the latter geocoded form was used for the public address.
